verdict.rationale: gstack documents a /learn skill that lets the user review, prune, and export what it has learned across sessions. Those learnings are stored locally in a known per-project file, so the user has some first-party control over deleting retained agent memory. The control is narrow and thinly documented. Missing for 10: retention policies or automatic expiry, documented deletion for per-site domain skills and other stored data, deletion controls for telemetry data, and independent or hands-on corroboration that pruning works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Review, search, prune, and export what gstack has learned across sessions.
